blocks.text: ‘PIETA’ IN PASAY. The shot by Raffy Lerma, published by the Inquirer on July 24, 2016, shows a pedicab driver in the arms of his anguished partner after being killed by motorcycle-riding gunmen in Pasay City. The assailants also left a sign at the scene calling their victim a “pusher.” (Inquirer File Photo) MANILA, Philippines
